title: solar
description: v0.1 device-model entity: a solar charge controller (MPPT/PWM), regardless of vendor. Published under renewvan/solar/<id>/<property>. One entity per controller. `power_w` and `battery_voltage_v` are required of every source; the rest is optional because cheap controllers do not report it.

power_w.description: Instantaneous power harvested from the panels, in watts.

battery_voltage_v.description: Voltage on the controller's battery (output) side.

battery_current_a.description: Optional: current delivered to the battery. Positive = into the battery.

pv_voltage_v.description: Optional: voltage on the panel (input) side.

yield_today_wh.description: Optional: energy harvested since local midnight (or the controller's own day boundary), in watt-hours.

yield_history_wh.description: Optional: the controller's own daily energy log, in watt-hours, as one retained JSON array, newest first. Index 0 is the controller's current day, so it equals `yield_today_wh`; index 1 is the previous day, and so on. The array is as long as the controller has days logged, so it may be shorter than the controller's maximum (a new controller has fewer) and is never padded. `null` marks a day the controller has no data for; it is not `0`, which is a real day that harvested nothing. Every value comes from the controller's own log, never computed or interpolated by a device. See docs/adr/0009.

charge_state.description: Optional: the controller's own charge stage. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback for any code not in this enum.
